purpose: Validate the Skill's own diversion-specialist workflow without using third-party cases or claiming platform ground truth.
copyright_policy: Every case in this file is original synthetic content created for Media Publish Check.

cases.evidence_scope: Complete spoken script and subtitle text; visual track is not supplied.
cases.input: 口播：想拿到桌面整理模板的，在评论里留下‘整理’，我再把个人联系方式发给你。字幕与口播一致。
must_not_claim: 画面不存在二维码或联系方式
cases.reason: The viewer is directed toward off-platform contact; absent visuals must remain an evidence gap.

cases.evidence_scope: Four-shot visual description and on-screen text are supplied; no separate audio file is supplied.
cases.input: 镜头 1：讲解资料整理。镜头 2：展示笔记页面。镜头 3（00:16）：右下角出现二维码，动态线条指向二维码，画面字为‘扫描查看站外完整版’。镜头 4：结尾。
must_not_claim: 二维码用途已获平台允许
cases.reason: The visual material itself creates an off-platform action expectation.

cases.evidence_scope: Complete spoken script and subtitle text; no cover or visual track is supplied.
cases.input: 口播：安装‘清单盒子’后输入邀请码，就能领取七天高级功能。字幕与口播一致。
must_not_claim: 虚构应用一定属于真实第三方产品
cases.reason: A fictional app is used solely to test an external install plus benefit-bound action pattern.

cases.evidence_scope: Script, subtitles and a statement that the linked product card is inside the target platform are supplied; video frames and music are not supplied.
cases.input: 口播：尺寸和材质都写在下方商品卡，价格以商品详情页展示为准。字幕与口播一致；商品卡为当前平台内商品卡。
must_not_claim: 商品卡一定对所有账号可用
cases.reason: The specialist should not invent an off-platform issue, but incomplete video evidence prevents a full publish pass.

cases.evidence_scope: Complete spoken script and subtitle text; no visual track is supplied.
cases.input: 口播：想看这位摄影师的完整系列，请去图文社区搜索他的同名账号。字幕与口播一致。
cases.reason: The sample tests an explicit viewer action toward an external destination without naming a real platform.

cases.evidence_scope: Visual description is supplied; spoken script and subtitles are not supplied.
cases.input: 镜头 2（00:09）：桌面上的卡片清楚显示‘合作邮箱：hello@example.test’，卡片下方有箭头和文字‘写信领取合作资料’。
cases.reason: The fictional address is a visual off-platform contact path.

cases.evidence_scope: Complete spoken script and subtitle text; no visual track is supplied.
cases.input: 口播：这个收纳方法我用了三个月，今天只分享步骤和材料选择。字幕与口播一致。
must_not_claim: 不存在画面或音轨风险
cases.reason: A clean specialist-control case confirms the module can avoid inventing diversion findings.

cases.evidence_scope: Complete spoken script and subtitle text; no visual track is supplied.
cases.input: 口播：这件工具是在另一个电商平台买到的，后面我只讲自己的使用过程。字幕与口播一致。
